name: Banana Club Mania
source:
During Christmas, a virgin guy got a free ticket to the Banana Club. Once there, he can choose from 3 girls for custom play with him. Depending on how he plays, the girls might become his steady girlfriend.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160404053637/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-a.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]

圣诞节期间，一位没有性经验的男子得到了一张“香蕉俱乐部”的免费入场券。到那里后，他可以从三位女孩中选择一位，与她进行自己指定的亲密游戏。根据相处方式的不同，女孩也可能成为他的固定女友。
